J8.note: Yellow line runs through the sky and clouds, roughly 5-7% of image height above the real hazy skyline across its whole width. It does not trace the distinctive central massif (the Tamaro-labelled summit area) or the notches, and the labels float in the sky.

U2.note: Nearly identical to J8: the line sits well above the visible skyline everywhere (about 5-7% of image height). No ridge features match, and the peak markers sit in the sky.

V7.note: The line is again well above the real skyline, and at the far right it climbs steeply to the top corner, well above the actual grassy near-field slope. No feature correspondence.

photoNote: The view looks down on Lake Lugano and the city from a high grassy ridge with a fence post. The distant skyline is hazy but visible at about 27-35% of image height, with a prominent central massif. On the right, a near-field grass slope cuts off the view.
